name: Notpla
tagline: Seaweed-based packaging that replaces single-use plastic
description: Develops packaging and coatings made from seaweed and plants as an alternative to single-use plastic.

name: Sofar Ocean
tagline: Real-time ocean data from a global network of Spotter buoys
description: Builds solar-powered Spotter buoys that report wind, wave, temperature and current data, and sells marine weather intelligence. Formed from the merger of OpenROV and Spoondrift.

name: Ocean Rainforest
description: Cultivates seaweed offshore in the Faroe Islands and develops seaweed products and markets.

name: Seabound
description: Builds carbon capture equipment that fits on ships to capture exhaust CO2 at the source. Y Combinator alumnus.

name: Oceanium
tagline: Seaweed biorefinery for food, materials and biodegradable products
description: Processes farmed kelp into food ingredients, biodegradable materials and other products through its biorefinery technology.

name: SeaForester
description: Marine restoration company focused on restoring kelp and other marine forests.

name: Kelp Blue
tagline: Giant kelp forests for carbon, biodiversity and biostimulants
description: Dutch-headquartered company cultivating giant kelp forests off Lüderitz, Namibia. Received the Zayed Sustainability Prize (Climate Action) at COP28.

name: Clearbot
tagline: Autonomous electric boats that collect floating waste
description: Spun out of University of Hong Kong students; builds self-driving electric boats that each collect 250-300 kg of waste per trip. Reported deployments in Hong Kong, India and Panama.
